verdict.rationale: Founder Law has a dedicated International Entrepreneur Parole page. It describes up to 30 months of parole for startup founders and states the CPI-adjusted thresholds: $264,147 from qualified U.S. investors or $105,659 in government awards or grants. The Techstars library also lists IE Parole among the topics it covers. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the firm actually handles IER filings, and explicit package pricing for the parole pathway.

support.subject: As a founder, the International Entrepreneur Rule (parole) is documented as an offered pathway, with its qualifying-investment thresholds stated

citations.quote: startup founders can obtain up to a 30-month immigration status called “Parole” to live in the U.S. with their families and scale their startup.
Your startup has received at least $264,147* from qualified U.S. investors or at least $105,659* in government awards or grants
